enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in bed with the air conditioner on for a cool night's rest
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down in bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Turn the head to the side. Shift the legs under the blanket. Roll onto the side. Keep the air conditioner running. Breathe slowly and remain asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing both legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the tap. Cup both hands under the water. Splash water on the face. Pick up the towel. Wipe the face. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto the toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth with water. Turn off the tap. Turn on the shower. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Apply soap. Rub the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Hang the towel on the rack. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with a large glass of water and checking the heatwave forecast on the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out eggs, bread and milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the power button on the induction cooker. Crack the eggs into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the eggs. Pick up a plate. Slide the eggs onto the plate. Pick up the kettle. Fill the kettle with water. Place the kettle on the base. Press the kettle switch. Open the cupboard. Take out a glass. Place the glass on the counter. Pick up the glass. Fill the glass with water from the tap. Drink the water. Pick up the plate and bread. Sit down at the table. Eat the eggs and bread. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Open the weather application. Look at the heatwave forecast. Place the phone on the table. Stand up. Carry the plate and glass to the sink. Rinse the plate and glass. Place them in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry and running the washing machine before the day gets hot
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Pick up the laundry basket. Open the laundry basket lid. Take out the clothes. Sort the clothes into two piles. Pick up the light-colored pile. Open the washing machine door. Put the clothes into the drum. Close the washing machine door. Open the detergent drawer. Pour detergent into the drawer. Close the detergent drawer. Press the power button on the washing machine. Turn the program dial to the wash cycle. Press the start button. Listen to the machine start. Turn off the light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing grocery shopping early in the morning to avoid the extreme heat
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of the house. Carry a reusable shopping bag. Walk along the street to the store. Enter the store. Pick up a shopping basket. Walk to the produce aisle. Pick up tomatoes. Place them in the basket. Pick up lettuce. Place it in the basket. Walk to the dairy aisle. Open the refrigerator door. Take out milk. Close the refrigerator door. Place the milk in the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place the items on the counter. Pay with the phone. Place the items into the reusable bag. Pick up the bag. Walk out of the store. Walk back to the house. Open the door. Enter the house.

enriched_activities.activity: Unpacking groceries, washing fresh produce and putting items in the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Place the bag on the counter. Take out the milk. Open the refrigerator door. Place the milk inside. Close the refrigerator door. Take out the tomatoes. Hold the tomatoes under the tap. Turn on the tap. Rub the tomatoes with the hands. Turn off the tap. Place the tomatoes on the cutting board. Take out the lettuce. Rinse the lettuce under the tap. Turn off the tap. Shake the lettuce. Place the lettuce in the refrigerator. Fold the reusable bag. Place the bag in the cupboard.

enriched_activities.activity: Vacuuming the living room and tidying up while staying out of the sun
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Turn on the living room light. Pick up clothes and cushions from the sofa. Place the cushions back on the sofa. Fold the blanket. Place the blanket on the sofa arm. Pick up cups from the coffee table. Carry the cups to the kitchen sink. Walk back to the living room. Open the storage closet. Take out the vacuum cleaner. Plug the vacuum cleaner into the outlet. Press the power button. Push the vacuum across the floor. Pull the vacuum back toward the body. Move the vacuum under the coffee table. Move the vacuum along the sofa edge. Move the vacuum to the corner. Press the power button to stop. Unplug the vacuum cleaner. Open the dust container. Empty the dust into the bin. Close the dust container. Place the vacuum cleaner back in the closet. Close the closet door. Adjust the cushion positions on the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light homemade lunch with the range hood on
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the tomatoes and lettuce. Close the refrigerator door. Place the vegetables on the counter. Pick up a knife. Cut the tomatoes on the cutting board. Place the tomato slices into a bowl. Tear the lettuce leaves. Add the lettuce to the bowl. Pick up the bottle of dressing. Pour dressing over the salad. Pick up a fork. Stir the salad. Press the range hood power button. Pick up the pan. Put the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Crack an egg into the pan. Pick up the spatula. Flip the egg. Press the induction cooker power button to turn off. Slide the egg onto a plate. Turn off the range hood. Carry the bowl and plate to the table. Sit down. Eat the salad and egg with the fork. Drink water from the glass. Stand up. Carry the dishes to the sink. Rinse the dishes. Place the dishes in the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the cool bedroom watching TV with the air conditioner set low
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Sit down on the bed. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button on the remote. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the bed. Lean back on the pillows. Adjust the pillow behind the back. Pull the blanket over the legs. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the phone. Place the phone on the bed. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the bed. Watch the TV screen. Shift the legs on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Completing online continuing education modules for health care practice on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Sit up on the bed. Stand up. Walk to the desk. Pull out the desk chair. Sit down on the chair. Open the laptop lid. Press the power button on the laptop. Type the password on the keyboard. Move the mouse. Click the browser icon. Type the learning platform address. Press Enter. Click the login field. Type the username. Click the password field. Type the password. Click the login button. Click the first module. Read the module text on the screen. Click the next button. Watch the video on the screen. Click the quiz link. Select the answer options with the mouse. Click the submit button. Open a notebook. Pick up a pen. Write notes on the page. Put down the pen. Click the next module. Scroll down the page with the mouse wheel. Click the finish button. Close the browser window.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a restful afternoon nap in the air-conditioned room
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the desk chair. Push the chair under the desk. Walk to the bed. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the side. Place the arm under the pillow. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed. Shift the legs. Turn onto the back. Keep eyes closed. Breathe slowly. Remain asleep on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing indoor stretching and bodyweight exercises in front of the fan
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up on the bed. Swing the legs off the bed. Stand up. Walk to the fan. Press the fan power button. Walk to the center of the room. Raise both arms above the head. Bend forward to touch the feet. Straighten up. Rotate the torso to the left. Rotate the torso to the right. Place the hands on the hips. Squat down. Stand up. Do push-ups on the floor. Stand up. Do lunges with the right leg. Do lunges with the left leg. Pick up the towel. Wipe the forehead with the towel. Pick up the water bottle. Open the bottle cap. Drink water. Close the bottle cap. Place the bottle on the floor. Press the fan power button to turn off.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading a book and drinking iced water while the space heater stays off
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the book from the coffee table. Open the book to the bookmark. Read the page. Turn the page. Read the next page. Pick up the glass of iced water from the coffee table. Drink the water. Place the glass back on the coffee table. Turn the page. Read the page. Close the book. Place the book on the coffee table. Stand up. Walk to the kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner using the induction cooker and oven
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the kitchen. Turn on the kitchen light. Open the refrigerator door. Take out the vegetables and chicken. Close the refrigerator door. Place the items on the counter. Pick up the knife. Cut the vegetables on the cutting board. Place the vegetables into a bowl. Pick up the chicken. Place the chicken on the baking tray. Open the oven door. Slide the tray into the oven. Close the oven door. Press the oven temperature dial. Turn the dial to the setting. Press the oven start button. Pick up the pan. Place the pan on the induction cooker. Press the induction cooker power button. Pour oil into the pan. Add the vegetables to the pan. Pick up the spatula. Stir the vegetables. Press the range hood power button. Add salt to the pan. Stir the vegetables. Press the induction cooker power button to turn off. Open the cupboard. Take out a plate. Place the vegetables on the plate. Pick up the oven mitt. Open the oven door. Pull out the tray. Close the oven door. Place the chicken on the plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner and cleaning up the table
enriched_activities.desc: Carry the plate to the table. Sit down on the chair. Pick up the fork. Cut the chicken with the fork. Eat the chicken and vegetables. Pick up the glass. Drink water. Place the glass on the table. Finish the meal. Stand up. Carry the plate to the sink. Turn on the tap. Rinse the plate under the water. Turn off the tap. Place the plate on the rack. Pick up the cloth. Wipe the table with the cloth. Rinse the cloth under the tap. Wring the cloth. Hang the cloth on the hook. Push the chair under the table. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and chatting on the phone to unwind
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the living room. Sit down on the sofa. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button. Aim the remote at the TV. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Tap the phone icon. Hold the phone to the ear. Speak into the phone. Listen to the other person. Say goodbye. Tap the end call button. Place the phone on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the sofa. Watch the TV screen. Lean back on the sofa.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and running the dehumidifier
enriched_activities.desc: Stand up from the sofa. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the bathroom light. Turn on the dehumidifier. Press the dehumidifier power button. Turn on the shower. Step into the shower. Wet the body. Apply soap. Rub the body. Rinse the body. Turn off the shower. Step out. Pick up the towel. Dry the body and hair. Hang the towel on the rack. Pick up the clothes. Put on the clothes. Pick up the toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto it. Brush teeth. Rinse the mouth. Place the toothbrush in the holder. Turn off the bathroom light. Walk out of the bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and scrolling on the phone under the ceiling fan and air conditioner
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into the bedroom. Press the fan power button. Pick up the air conditioner remote. Press the power button. Press the temperature button. Place the remote on the nightstand. Sit down on the bed. Lean back on the pillows. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button. Press the channel button. Place the remote on the bed. Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Scroll through the phone with the thumb. Tap a video. Watch the video on the phone. Tap the like button. Scroll down the feed. Tap the back button. Place the phone on the bed. Pick up the remote. Press the volume button. Place the remote on the bed. Watch the TV screen. Shift the legs on the bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Setting the alarm, dimming the desk lamp and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up the phone. Unlock the phone. Tap the clock application. Tap the alarm tab. Tap the add alarm button. Set the alarm time. Tap the save button. Place the phone on the nightstand. Reach to the desk lamp. Turn the desk lamp dial to dim. Press the desk lamp switch to turn off. Pick up the TV remote. Press the power button to turn off the TV. Place the remote on the nightstand. Pull back the blanket. Lie down on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Turn onto the side. Close eyes. Remain lying on the bed.
